title: [review] project-LICHEN-5pe7: dead import crypto_scalarmult_base in generate.py
description: In test/vectors/generate.py line 2183, 'from nacl.bindings import crypto_scalarmult_base' is imported but never used in the edhoc_vectors() function. The ephemeral keys are now passed in directly from deterministic seeds rather than derived via scalarmult. Remove the unused import.
